#!/bin/bash

# Backup Script for Markdown Files
# This script copies all .md files from the current directory to a backup directory

# Define the backup directory
BACKUP_DIR="./backup"

# Create the backup directory if it doesn't exist
if [ ! -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Creating backup directory: $BACKUP_DIR"
    mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
else
    echo "Backup directory already exists: $BACKUP_DIR"
fi

# Count the number of .md files to backup
MD_COUNT=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -type f | wc -l)

if [ "$MD_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "No .md files found to backup."
    exit 0
fi

echo "Found $MD_COUNT .md file(s) to backup."

# Copy all .md files from current directory to backup directory
echo "Copying .md files to $BACKUP_DIR..."
cp -v *.md "$BACKUP_DIR/" 2>/dev/null

# Verify the backup
BACKUP_COUNT=$(find "$BACKUP_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -type f | wc -l)

if [ "$BACKUP_COUNT" -eq "$MD_COUNT" ]; then
    echo "✓ Backup completed successfully!"
    echo "  $BACKUP_COUNT .md file(s) backed up to $BACKUP_DIR"
else
    echo "⚠ Warning: Expected $MD_COUNT files but found $BACKUP_COUNT in backup directory."
    exit 1
fi

exit 0

#!/bin/bash

# Backup Script for Markdown Files
# This script copies all .md files from the current directory to a backup directory

# Define the backup directory
BACKUP_DIR="./backup"

if [ ! -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]; then
